[CONTRIBUTION EVENT]
- Type: Time (Minutes)
- Amount: 150
- Description: 2.5h — China distribution discussion (with cacao meeting + Chinese mould-sourcing references)
  
  Pull requests (GitHub evidence):
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agentic_ai_context/pull/1835
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agentic_ai_context/pull/1836
  
  Details:
  2.5-hour discussion on distribution matters in China. Gary Teh. Filed per the governor's direction; TDG derived by the dao_client rubric SSOT (150/60*100 = 250.00).
  
  === WHAT THE ATTACHMENTS ACTUALLY SHOW (read this before relying on the entry) ===
  
  Five images were sent with this session. I analysed all five (the auto-OCR returned 0.0% — no text detected — so I used vision analysis instead of OCR). They do NOT depict distribution logistics. They show two different things:
  
  A. ONE MEETING PHOTOGRAPH
  Night-time outdoor restaurant/bar table, orange umbrellas, two people. One holds a green rectangular presentation box with gold "Cacao / CACAU" branding; the other is pointing at it. Neon signage, wine bottle, city lights behind. This is a face-to-face meeting at which a cacao product/presentation box was handed over and discussed. Who attended is NOT determinable from the image — neither face is identifiable to me and no name, badge or business card appears.
  
  B. FOUR CHINESE E-COMMERCE PRODUCT LISTINGS FOR CHOCOLATE MOULDS
  All four are screenshots of a mobile shopping app (Taobao/Tmall-style Chinese UI — tabs 宝贝/评价/详情/推荐, buttons 加入购物车/立即购买). Search term shown: 巧克力PC模具 ("chocolate PC mould"). Machine-read specifications:
    - Item no. 编号 QL-1585
    - Chocolate weight 克重 5g per piece
    - Finished size 成品尺寸 34*34*H4mm
    - Mould size 外模尺寸 275*175*H24mm
    - A 24-cavity tray, and separately a 35-cavity tray with a leaf/plant motif
    - Product spec sheet: Mould Size 275*175mm / Product Size 34*34*H4mm / Chocolate Weight 5g
    - English branding on packaging: "PROFESSIONAL CHOCOLATE MOLD", "NEW AUTOMATIC PRODUCTION", "MADE IN CHINA", "CHOCOLATE MOULD"
    - Material 食品级PC材料 (food-grade PC)
    - Product shots show dark chocolate squares with an embossed cacao-pod design
  
  So the evidence supports: a meeting took place, and Chinese mould tooling was being sourced/specified. It does NOT evidence freight, warehousing, customs, importer-of-record, distributor terms, retail listings, or any logistics flow. The 2.5 hours are the governor's account of the conversation; the attachments corroborate that a China-side meeting and mould sourcing were part of it, not the distribution substance itself.
  
  === WHY THE MOULD SPECS ARE COMMERCIALLY USEFUL (the real value in this pack) ===
  
  Unprompted, this pack pins down a concrete SKU format: 5 g square pieces, 34 x 34 x H4 mm finished, from a 275 x 175 x H24 mm food-grade PC mould, at 24- and 35-cavity counts. That is a manufacturing-spec level of detail that matters for:
    - mould/tooling cost per cavity count
    - piece weight driving cacao input cost per unit (5 g x N pieces per box)
    - box dimensional planning against the 34 mm square footprint
    - whether a 24- vs 35-cavity mould is the better unit-economics choice at volume
  
  It also continues the SKU thread from the 2026-11-18 3-hour Nathan LUI printing session and, by extension, the standing open follow-up "Introduce Lawrence Kwek to the China team once China-side packaging is settled" (OPEN_FOLLOWUPS.md:507, filed 2026-10-19).
  
  === CAVEATS RECORDED HONESTLY ===
  
  1. ATTENDEE UNKNOWN. The meeting photo does not identify who was present. I am not asserting Nathan LUI, Lawrence Kwek, or any named party was in the room. The governor can name them in conversation; it is not in the pixels.
  2. NO PRICING. None of the five images carry a mould price, MOQ, tooling cost, unit cacao cost, freight rate, or distributor margin. The e-commerce screenshots are product listings, not quotes — the app's price field is not legible in any of the four.
  3. NO DISTRIBUTION ARTEFACT. No shipping document, warehouse photo, customs paper, contract, or territory map appears. If distribution terms were agreed in this session, that agreement exists nowhere in the attached evidence.
  4. VISION-READ, NOT OCR-VERIFIED. The Chinese strings above came from a vision model, not from Tesseract (which found nothing — the screenshots are dark and low-contrast in Tesseract's judgement). The alphanumeric specs (QL-1585, 5g, 34*34*H4mm, 275*175*H24mm, 24/35 cavity) are internally consistent across four independent images, which is reasonable corroboration, but a human glance at pages 2-5 is advised before these are used to place a tooling order.
  
  === ATTACHMENT ===
  
  china_distribution_evidence_2026-11-20.pdf (5 pages), mirrored at:
  https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agentic_ai_context/blob/main/contributions/evidence/2026-11-20_china_distribution_evidence.pdf
  p1 meeting photograph; p2-p5 the four Chinese e-commerce mould listings, each with its machine-read specification captioned.
  
  PR FIELD NOTE: an operational/discussion contribution has no PR of its own. The two PR URLs cited carry the PDF artefact + evidence-index work from this same thread and are included only because the reporting tool requires a pull URL and rejects non-pull links.
- Contributor(s): Gary Teh
- TDG Issued: 250.00
- Attached Filename: china_distribution_evidence_2026-11-20.pdf
- Destination Contribution File Location: https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/.github/tree/main/assets/china_distribution_evidence_2026-11-20.pdf
